title: SQL Injection - Login Bypass
impact: Allows unauthorized access to the administrator account without knowing the password.
remediation: Use parameterized SQL queries and properly validate user input.

title: SQL Injection - User Data Dump via Product Search (UNION)

impact: Extracts user email addresses and password hashes through the product search endpoint

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
impact: Allows injected JavaScript to execute in a victim's browser when a crafted tracking URL is opened in order tracking feature.
remediation: Encode untrusted output according to its HTML context; validate URL parameters and avoid unsafe DOM rendering.

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
impact: Allows injected JavaScript to execute when a page displays stored user-controlled content
screenshot: Encode untrusted data before displaying it; sanitize permitted HTML and validate user input on the server.
